Built for the QuantUM Qiskit Fall Fest Challenge Protocol: toric surface code · player decoder · greedy reference decoder

HOW IT WORKS

A surface code detects endpoints, not paths.

  1. Physical errors form chains along data-qubit edges.
  2. Vertex stabilizers report odd parity at chain endpoints.
  3. The decoder connects detection events using a likely correction path.
  4. If error + correction wraps around the periodic surface, the syndrome is clear—but the logical qubit has flipped.

This educational prototype uses a greedy minimum-distance decoder. Production systems often use minimum-weight perfect matching or more advanced decoders.
